Package hadur2.core.memory

Class Bytes.Reader

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.memory.Bytes.Reader
Enclosing class:
Bytes
static final class Bytes.Reader extends Object
Reads big-endian values from buf[start, end). Every read checks the bounds first and throws ProfileFormatException rather than ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, so a truncated or lying length field is reported as damage (MEM-4).
